name: DiscAgeAI
description: DiscAgeAI combines 3D CNN volumetric analysis of lumbar MRI scans with biomechanical metadata regression to predict intervertebral disc biological age and degeneration grade. Implements a ResNet-SE multi-task architecture with amplitude-aware training, test-time augmentation, and 5-fold ensemble scoring. Features a LangChain/Groq clinical narrative layer that generates structured radiological reports. Patent filed under Indian Patent Office. Dataset: private clinical collaboration with orthopaedic research partners.
reported_outcome: Patent Filed. R² = 0.70 with 2.58-year MAE using 2.5D CNN sensor fusion.
